biggest_catch: Modest fees ($10-20 typical), monthly payout, and no mileage reimbursement.
catches: Typical fees $10-20; reimbursement for food/drinks only, not mileage.
PayPal/direct deposit between the 15th and 25th of the following month — slow cash flow.
First shop requires a briefing call with a scheduler.

c2.evidence: Pays via PayPal between the 15th and 25th for work performed the prior month (mysteryshoppermagazine; moneystrugglesuccess).

c3.evidence: Pay scale $10-20 typical; retail try-on shop example paid $45 fee; set fee + food/drink reimbursement per shop.

eligibility: US (Midwest concentration); free signup; writing samples requested; first assignment needs scheduler briefing call
notes: DEMOTED by coordinator adjudication 2026-09-23: real legitimate no-fee program with confirmed timing, but no official numeric pay ($0-$0 variable). Owner rule: concrete payout required on every card. Documented for future if official numeric terms surface. Original: Official scam-warning page is notable: 'Customer Impact never pays in advance, and we never pay with checks — only through Direct Deposit & PayPal.' Any mailed check claiming to be from Customer Impact is a scam. Also runs retail merchandising assignments (merchandisers paid 20th-25th of following month).
payout_quote: Customer Impact pays via PayPal between the 15th and 25th for work performed the prior month. When you complete a shopping report, you'll also be paid a set fee (on top of food/drink reimbursement).

s1.note: Set fee + food/drink reimbursement distinguished in terms.

s4.note: Free signup; official scam page denies fee-charging.

s5.note: Job board shows pay and terms per assignment.

s7.note: Shopper forum comments overwhelmingly positive, but availability varies by market.

steps: Register free at customerimpactinfo.com (Sassie application + writing samples)
View job board and apply for shops in your area
Complete scheduler briefing call before your first assignment
Do the shop and submit your report
Get paid via PayPal or direct deposit between the 15th and 25th of the following month
timing: Paid between the 15th and 25th of the month following the shop, via PayPal or direct deposit. Never by mailed check.
maximize: Put real effort into the writing samples at signup — report quality is the entire job. And remember the scam test: the real Customer Impact only pays by PayPal or direct deposit, so any mailed check in their name is fake.
